SOURCE = VertexCover
Vertex Cover.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has a vertex cover of AT MOST k vertices: a set of
vertices that includes at least one endpoint of every edge.

Edge cases: k < 0 is always no. A graph with no edges is yes for every
k >= 0 (the empty set covers it). k >= n is yes, since all vertices cover
every edge.

TARGET = Clique
Clique.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has a clique of AT LEAST k vertices: k vertices with an
edge between every two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k = 1 is yes whenever n >= 1. k > n is
always no.

"""Polynomial-time reduction from Vertex Cover to Clique.

A set S is a vertex cover of G iff V \\ S is an independent set in G,
i.e. a clique in the complement graph of G.  Therefore G has a vertex
cover of size at most k iff the complement of G has a clique of size at
least n - k.

So the reduction maps (G, k) to (complement(G), n - k).
"""


def reduce(instance):
    n = instance["n"]
    k = instance["k"]
    edges = instance["edges"]

    # Build the set of existing (undirected) edges, normalized as (min, max).
    present = set()
    for u, v in edges:
        if u > v:
            u, v = v, u
        present.add((u, v))

    # Complement graph: all pairs 0 <= u < v < n that are not edges of G.
    complement_edges = []
    for u in range(n):
        for v in range(u + 1, n):
            if (u, v) not in present:
                complement_edges.append([u, v])

    return {"n": n, "edges": complement_edges, "k": n - k}
EOF

- no edges: source yes for k>=0. Complement is complete graph, k' = n-k. Clique of size at least n-k exists in complete graph when n-k <= n i.e. k>=0. Good.
- k >= n: source yes. k' = n-k <= 0, target k'<=0 => yes. Good.
